set: CPA 23-037A, A-100 to A-106 (7 plans, floors 4 to 11)
_doc: Levels top-down, one per C-BASE row starting at row 93. 'elev' is the level's
elevation (ft, from A-200). 'slab_from' is the engine floor whose tributary
areas, facade lengths and KLL stand for the slab AT this level; 'assumed' marks
levels not in the drawing set. 'sdl', 'll' (psf) and 'slab_in' describe that
slab. The firm's sheet charges each column segment with the slab one level up,
so the bottom level's slab is not carried by any segment (slab on grade).
Loads per the engineer: dead 112.5 psf on every slab (a 9 in slab's self-weight, SDL 0), live 40 psf everywhere, 100 psf on the top floor (11th) slab.

levels.note: No bulkhead slab in the set; row kept for the template.
